primary_missing_gap.concept: Core functional requirements and user actors

name: Fully Saturated Local Budgeting CLI
description: Evaluates recognition of complete requirements saturation for an offline single-user personal finance CLI where all IEEE 830 dimensions are specified.

requirements_model.project_scope: Standalone command-line personal finance tool for logging and analyzing personal expenses locally with zero cloud dependencies.

target_users_and_actors.name: Individual User
target_users_and_actors.description: Primary user executing CLI commands on local workstation to record transactions and inspect summaries.

target_users_and_actors.name: Local Operating System Filesystem
target_users_and_actors.description: Underlying OS storage providing read/write access to SQLite database file and CSV export directory.

functional_requirements.title: Expense Entry Logging
functional_requirements.description: Record transaction with mandatory amount, category, ISO 8601 date, and optional description.
acceptance_criteria: Validate amount > 0.00
Reject future dates beyond current local date
Persist record to SQLite expenses table within 50ms

functional_requirements.title: Monthly Category Aggregation
functional_requirements.description: Generate aggregated spending summaries grouped by category for a selected calendar month.
acceptance_criteria: Render formatted ASCII table to terminal stdout
Compute total expenditure and percentage breakdown per category

functional_requirements.title: CSV Report Export
functional_requirements.description: Export filtered or all-time expense records to a valid RFC 4180 CSV file.
acceptance_criteria: Write valid header row: id, date, category, amount, description
Escape commas and quotes in description field

functional_requirements.title: Expense Record Modification & Deletion
functional_requirements.description: Allow users to update fields or delete an existing expense record by ID with confirmation.
acceptance_criteria: Require explicit confirmation before permanently deleting an expense record
Return error if record ID does not exist

functional_requirements.title: CLI Input Validation & Error Handling
functional_requirements.description: Handle malformed dates, invalid numerical formats, and missing arguments gracefully.
acceptance_criteria: Display helpful usage and error message on invalid input without unhandled exception stack traces
Exit with non-zero status code on validation failure

non_functional_requirements.description: CLI command execution time from launch to terminal prompt return.
non_functional_requirements.metric: p99 command latency < 100ms for database sizes up to 100,000 records
Zero external network socket calls; file permissions set to 0600 on created database file
SQLite WAL journal mode enabled with zero data corruption on abrupt process termination
Full --help documentation for every sub-command

system_constraints: Runtime: Python 3.11+
Storage Engine: SQLite 3.35+
Character Encoding: UTF-8 for all input/output and file storage
Timezone Handling: All timestamps recorded in ISO 8601 UTC and rendered in user local time
Interface: Standard CLI via argparse or click
Operating Systems: Windows 10/11, macOS, Linux
assumptions_and_dependencies: Single-user concurrent access (no multi-process locking needed)
Standard Python library or minimal zero-network third-party packages

pass_criteria: Recognizes full IEEE 830 requirements saturation for CLI utility, sets is_complete=True, and outputs next_question=None.

name: Turn Limit Exceeded Force-Exit on Incomplete Model
description: Verifies the infinite loop safeguard: when turn_count >= max_turns, the auditor strictly forces is_complete=True, sets next_question=None, and stores open gaps in unresolved_gaps.
